scope: All 200 old vertices and their three singleton-neighbor choices: 600 labelled 1+2 adjacent vertex splits, equivalent to subdividing each of the 300 source edges with two labellings.
prediction: At least one of the 600 labelled splits retains diameter at most 7.
intuition: The source connects five subdivided Wagner blocks through four 20-cycles. A split at a connector can separate its cycle routes from its block route. The degree-two root has radius-seven nonbacktracking capacity 255, above 201; whether these two route families retain complementary coverage is the actual test.

D6_screen.conclusion: The same cubic split cannot yield diameter six on 133 vertices, independent of source.

complete_check: For each split at v, BFS the new root and every old root in the source closed radius-three ball of v. Any original path of length at most seven between two roots outside that ball avoids v and is retained.
stop: First complete hit, or all 600 cases, or 30 CPU seconds. No extra edge changes or bad-pair repair.
